item.title: When will Americans get $2,000 tariff dividends? Donald Trump speaks out
item.description: President Trump has hinted at $2,000 tariff dividend checks for Americans in 2026, funded by tariff revenue. These payments, potentially excluding high-income earners, are still under discussion. Legal challenges to existing tariffs and the need for congressional approval present significant hurdles for the plan.
item.dc:creator: TOI Business Desk

item.title: Internet torches Donald Trump after Epstein emails link him to ‘Bubba,’ alleged to be Bill Clinton: ‘Worst damage control’
item.description: Newly leaked Epstein emails sparked outrage, with many interpreting a phrase as a crude sexual reference involving Donald Trump and "Bubba," a nickname for Bill Clinton. Trump dismissed the controversy as a politically motivated hoax, while social media users noted the timing of White House "power couple" posts. The internet reacted with jokes and demands for clarity on "Bubba's" identity.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Scott Bessent grilled after giving wild reason for soaring beef prices in US: 'Cows climbing over Trump’s wall'
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent attributed rising US beef prices to an alleged "invasion of cows" across the southern border, claiming migrants brought livestock and a disease. However, there is no credible evidence linking migrant-transported livestock to domestic beef prices, with experts citing supply chain and economic factors as primary drivers.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Oscar-winning actor calls Zohran Mamdani a ‘communist fool’, says only Trump can save New York
item.description: Actor Jon Voight has strongly criticized Zohran Mamdani's election as New York City mayor. Voight fears Mamdani will turn the city into a socialist state. He urged Donald Trump to step in to prevent this. Mamdani's win has divided public figures, with some celebrating and others criticizing his policies. His platform focuses on social housing and workers' rights.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Noam Chomsky was named in leaked Epstein emails, and the political left is not happy: 'Manufacturing consent for child rapist'
item.description: Leaked emails reveal linguist Noam Chomsky met with Jeffrey Epstein multiple times between 2015 and 2017. Discussions covered academic and personal topics, with Chomsky stating Epstein donated to MIT where he taught. The revelations have drawn criticism from some socialists.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: xQc calls Asmongold’s “ideal America” policies unaffordable and unrealistic
item.description: Streamer xQc ignited a debate by critiquing an animated depiction of Asmongold's "ideal America." He argued the proposed policies, while theoretically appealing, would lead to national bankruptcy due to "diminishing returns" and immense financial strain. xQc emphasized that such grand plans are costly and impractical for real-world governance, highlighting the gap between idealism and economic reality.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Indian traveller faces racist trolling on social media while visiting Argentina, but locals have his back
item.description: An Indian traveler, Thiru, faced racist remarks on X after arriving in Argentina for a conference. However, the local Argentinian community rallied to offer warm welcomes and condemn the hate. This outpouring of support overwhelmed the negative comments, demonstrating social media's dual capacity for both negativity and unity, ultimately ensuring a positive experience for Thiru.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Jeffrey Epstein’s brother reveals ‘Bubba’ in alleged sex-scandal emails with Trump is not Bill Clinton, it is…
item.description: Mark Epstein clarified that 'Bubba' in a leaked email wasn't Bill Clinton, calling it a private joke. However, other released emails suggest Donald Trump knew about underage girls and spent time with a victim at Epstein's home, sparking calls for further investigation and White House denials.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Immigrant crackdown: UK govt set to overhaul asylum system – what’s changing
item.description: The UK government is set to implement extensive asylum rule changes, modelled on Denmark's strict system, to curb irregular arrivals and deter migrants. New plans will introduce temporary protection status and significantly lengthen the path to settlement for those arriving illegally, aiming to restore public confidence and reduce pressure on communities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Marjorie Taylor Greene apologises after alleging Trump is threatening her amid H1-B, Epstein files row: ‘I’m sorry for being part of...’
item.description: Marjorie Taylor Greene apologized for her role in "toxic politics" on CNN, citing the "assassination" of Charlie Kirk as a turning point. This rare admission follows a public rift with Donald Trump, who withdrew his support, calling her "wacky." Greene claims Trump's attacks are an attempt to intimidate Republicans ahead of a vote on the Epstein files.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Never forget’: Elon Musk shares clip claiming Biden, Harris sent forklift to open border for illegal immigrants
item.description: Elon Musk reignited a border dispute by sharing a video of U.S. Border Patrol using a forklift to lift Texas-installed razor wire. The clip, originally from September 2024, highlights ongoing tensions between Texas and federal authorities over border enforcement strategies and legal responsibilities.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Vivek is ‘flying around in his private jet’: Republican rival hits back at Ramaswamy’s ‘lazy, mediocre’ comment on Ohioans
item.description: Democratic candidate Amy Acton criticized Republican rival Vivek Ramaswamy, accusing him of being out of touch with Ohioans and calling his past remarks about residents being "lazy" and "mediocre" inaccurate. Ramaswamy, in turn, labeled Acton "Dr Lockdown," blaming her for early COVID-19 school closures. The rivalry intensifies as the election approaches.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: SNL recap: Glenn Powell's maverick act, Epstein files, 6-7 meme and the day after Taken
item.description: Glenn Powell made his SNL hosting debut, sharing personal anecdotes and promoting his new movie. The episode tackled topical issues with sketches mocking Donald Trump's Epstein email revelations and exploring AI's uncanny valley. Other segments included a military-themed runway parody and a musical sketch about missing exes' dads.
item.dc:creator: Aman Xess

item.title: Oman launches emergency passport renewal service at Muscat International Airport
item.description: Omani citizens can now access an emergency passport renewal service at Muscat International Airport for urgent travel situations. The facility is available only for passports with less than six months’ validity and requires a confirmed flight ticket. Applicants must provide original documents verifying the emergency, such as medical reports or official memos. Standard renewal procedures at police centres remain unchanged.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Pray for my mom’s safety’: Marjorie Taylor Greene’s daughter speaks out as Trump feud over H1-B, Epstein files becomes a ‘hotbed of threats’
item.description: Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene's daughter expressed concern for her mother's safety after Greene criticized Donald Trump over the Epstein files and H1-B visas. Greene reported receiving security warnings, attributing the threats to Trump's rhetoric. Trump subsequently withdrew his endorsement and publicly denounced Greene, escalating their public dispute.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Zelenskyy government shaken by $100 million corruption scandal as top officials resign
item.description: A $100 million corruption scandal within Ukraine's state nuclear energy sector has led to the resignation of top officials and intensified pressure on President Zelenskyy's wartime leadership. A 15-month investigation uncovered a kickback network involving figures close to the president, with funds allegedly diverted from crucial equipment meant to protect power sites from Russian attacks.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Oman Air updates safety rules for lithium batteries, power banks, smart bags, and e-cigarettes
item.description: Oman Air has updated safety rules for lithium batteries, power banks, smart bags, and e-cigarettes to ensure passenger safety. Power banks and e-cigarettes must stay in hand luggage, smart bag batteries may need removal, and lithium battery-powered devices like hoverboards are banned. Devices can be charged under supervision, but loose batteries and vapes cannot be used or charged onboard.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: How astronomers recorded the fragmentation of Comet C/2025 K1 ATLAS and how you can witness its remains this month
item.description: Comet C/2025 K1 (ATLAS) has fragmented after its close solar approach, revealing insights into the fragility of long-period comets. New images show distinct pieces drifting apart, a process likely caused by internal gas pressure and structural weakness. This disintegration offers a real-time view of cometary evolution under intense solar heating.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: How 39,000-year-old ancient RNA from a mammoth found in Siberia reveals its biology
item.description: Scientists have recovered ancient RNA from a 39,000-year-old woolly mammoth in Siberia, offering an unprecedented glimpse into its biology. Preserved by permafrost, the RNA reveals gene activity related to muscle, cell maintenance, and stress, providing insights into the Ice Age giant's life and cellular functions. This discovery highlights the remarkable endurance of biomolecules and the potential of frozen archives.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Oman airports becomes world's first to roll out Wi-Fi 7 in partnership with Huawei
item.description: Oman Airports has become the first airport in the world to deploy Wi-Fi 7, in partnership with Huawei. The new system offers faster, more secure, and reliable connectivity for passengers, enhancing the travel experience. The upgrade aligns with Oman’s Vision 2040, modernizing airport operations and showcasing the nation’s commitment to advanced technology and innovation in aviation.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
